# SEAWATER SUPPLY CO

SEAWATER SUPPLY CO is a 24/7 ship supplier and ship chandler based in Cartagena, Colombia, serving vessels in all Colombian ports.

## Services

- Fresh and dry provisions, groceries, meat, dairy, fruits and vegetables
- Bonded store products, beverages, toiletries and cleaning supplies
- Marine spare parts, valves, flanges, gaskets, seals, filters and tools
- Navigation charts, maritime publications, logbooks, flags and marine lighting

## Service Area

All Colombian ports, including Cartagena, Barranquilla, Santa Marta and Buenaventura.
